typography.pairing_strategy: Outfit for headings (modern, tech, premium), Plus Jakarta Sans for body (excellent legibility for data tables, metrics, and Indonesian language).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 for cards to create structure without visual clutter.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Subtle neon cyan box-shadow for primary buttons and active states (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.2)]).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky topbar/navbar and modals: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070B14]/70 border-b border-white/10.

layouts.app_shell: Persistent left sidebar (collapsible, w-64 expanded, w-20 collapsed, mobile drawer). Sticky top header for contextual actions, page title, and user profile.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Dense bento grid style for dashboard widgets. Use gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children of grid.
layouts.page_container: p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto w-full.

components.sidebar: Darker than surface or matching background (bg-[#070B14]). Active menu item gets primary text color, primary-tinted background (bg-primary/10), and a left vertical 2px solid primary indicator.
components.topbar: Glassmorphic sticky header (z-50). Must not be fully transparent. Contains global date/month filter, notifications, and profile.
components.cards: bg-[#111623] rounded-xl border border-white/10 overflow-hidden. No heavy shadows in dark mode.
components.data_table: Dense data tables. Wrapper: overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-white/10. Table: w-full text-sm left-align. th: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 bg-[#070B14] py-3 px-4 font-medium. tr: border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors. td: py-3 px-4 align-middle.
components.tabs: Specific to Data Omset: Flex container, p-1 bg-[#070B14] rounded-lg inline-flex border border-white/10. Tab items: px-6 py-2.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all. Active state: bg-[#111623] text-primary shadow-sm. Inactive state: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-[#070B14] font-semibold rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#33EAFF] transition-colors shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,229,255,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-[#070B14] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary transition-all w-full.
components.modals: Framer-motion powered. Backdrop: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50. Modal Content: bg-[#111623] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-6 relative.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion on main content: initial={opacity:0, y:10} animate={opacity:1, y:0} exit={opacity:0, y:-10} transition={duration:0.2, ease:'easeOut'}
motion.modals: Backdrop: initial={opacity:0} animate={opacity:1}. Modal: initial={opacity:0, scale:0.95} animate={opacity:1, scale:1} transition={duration:0.2, type:'spring', bounce:0}
motion.hover_states: Buttons use transition-colors. Avoid heavy scale transforms on dense ERP interfaces; prioritize color shifts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets 4.5:1 ratio against surface. Cyan #00E5FF against #070B14 is highly accessible.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#070B14]).
accessibility.test_ids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='tab-data-gmv', data-testid='login-submit-button').

specific_instructions.data_omset_page: Implement a single page for 'Data Omset' with a prominent tab switcher for [ DATA GMV ] and [ KOMISI REAL ]. Do not create separate sidebar menus for these. They share the same route, state switches the view.
specific_instructions.logo_usage: Login page: Display the full provided asset prominently. Sidebar/Header: Render the text 'PT.KDRT' in the Outfit font, styled as chrome/neon or simply a crisp white/cyan text, rather than just using the brain icon alone. The user explicitly requested: 'untuk di ikon jangan hanya brainnya tapi tulisan PT.KDRT nya untuk sidebar/header'.
specific_instructions.tech_stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, lucide-react, framer-motion. You have .js files (using JSX syntax), do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript files. Build custom components using Tailwind CSS; DO NOT use shadcn/ui.
specific_instructions.language: All labels, menus, and text must be in Bahasa Indonesia as requested.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, using background color shifts (surface layers) instead of drop shadows in dark mode.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background in the header, overlays, or any surface that has content scrolling under it.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors, transition-transform.
Do NOT use emoji characters (🤖🧠). Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Keep text left-aligned for data density; only center-align empty states or specific modal content.
Do not use generic blue/purple AI slop gradients. Stick to the sharp, premium Neon Cyan (#00E5FF) on Void Navy (#070B14) aesthetic.
You have .js files not .tsx file, so strictly write React components in .js files.
